services.name: private charter
services.desc: Our whale watching yacht, the Odyssey, is ideal for whale watching and all types of private charters and special occasions. Whether it is a school field trip, family reunion, company outing, wedding group or any other special occasion. We can arrange private charters departing from Friday Harbor, Bellingham, Anacortes, Lopez Island, Orcas Island, Seattle and other places in the greater Puget Sound area. Perfect for seeing Orca whales. In the fall and winter we have even done Thanksgiving and holiday charters. We are happy to arrange catering services for you. services.name: orca whales
services.desc: Because whales are wildlife and are unpredictable we can't guarantee orca whales, gray whales or minke whales on every trip. What we can guarantee is that if you don't see a whale on your trip with us then we will let you go out again for free, for this reason if you are here for a few days plan your trip with us at the beginning of your vacation. services.name: sea kayaking
services.desc: Sea kayak along the west-side of San Juan Island... beautiful scenery and amazing wildlife! Meet us at our launch site at Snug Harbor or use our complimentary shuttle from the ferry in Friday Harbor. Our tours depart from custom kayak docks and are led by naturalist guides. 3 hour, full day, sunset and multi-day kayaking and multi-sport trips in Washington's sunny San Juan Islands - mid March through mid October. The perfect adventure for singles, couples, groups, and families - no experience is necessary. and the many other San Juan Islands for an experience of a lifetime.
